description: This file defines the OptionalFieldController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for optional fields in the preRender method.

classes.name: OptionalFieldController
classes.description: A controller that manages the optional fields view, extending functionality from AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component for optional fields and assigns it for rendering.
